input.selection: 16 roots with the greatest exact legal-move count

d1071.meaning: strict-subset and provenance-loss correctness falsifier; not a cold/warm timing

coldWarm.procedure: compile the same highest-legal-count root once, insert it, then read its exact id from the same in-process cache

eventAndReadingCorrected.coefficientBasis: the equal-item control adds 6,629 readings and 39,503,176 heap bytes over event-only; incremental reading/event heap ratio 4.31, rounded up

derived.finding: events + readings is not a memory-homogeneous retained-item unit
derived.correctedTrial: events + 5 * readings keeps both scopes under the declared weight bound and reduces the mixed cache from eight to six stress roots

limitations: RSS is a fresh-process high-water delta and includes allocator pages touched during compilation, not only bytes resident in the final cache.
The coefficient is calibrated on the 16 highest-legal-count fixed roots; implementation must keep the equal-item negative control and re-run the receipt on the production compiler.
No numeric core/cpu release memory ceiling exists yet, so this receipt can compare mechanisms but cannot decide whether 67.17 MB heap / 259.95 MB RSS uplift clears the appliance tier.
